production.audience: Children aged four to seven, English-speaking
narrative_rules: Use simple concrete English suited to ages four to seven.
Tell one calm, self-contained story with at most two main characters.
Let a small problem be solved through a clear action and kind help.
End with safety, reassurance and a resolved situation.
No frightening threats, adult themes, dangerous imitation, mockery or promotional calls to action.
visual_rules: Warm storybook illustrations with readable shapes and soft colors.
Keep each character, outfit and important prop consistent across all six scenes.
Describe one clear visible moment per scene; no frantic action or flashes.
